descFull: NowenReader（弄文阅读）是开源自托管的漫画与小说书库。支持飞牛 fnOS 和 Docker 部署，自动扫描入库，按目录和标签找书。电脑上读到哪，手机上接着读。 | An open-source, self-hosted library for comics and novels. Deploy on fnOS or with Docker, scan your collection automatically, browse by folder or tag, and pick up where you left off on your phone.
